name: Push the Talking Trash Can
def: Radio controlled talking trash can robot that toured Tomorrowland at several Disney parks and still patrols Hong Kong Disneyland daily.
facts: Appeared at Disneyland, Disney California Adventure, Disneyland Paris and Tokyo Disneyland
Formerly also roamed the Magic Kingdom at Walt Disney World
